notes: Prismatic Song Reactor, 4x4: a gem-cut violet frame round a tall crystal that sings: concentric rings of cyan and magenta light spread outward from its white-gold core on the 6-frame loop, with four small tuning crystals in the corners that light in turn. Off: a dull dark crystal, no rings. Damaged: the crystal is cracked and a corner crystal dark, the rings stutter. Disabled: the crystal split and grey, the frame cracked. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
